prompt: Use case: texture generation for a real-time game. Use the supplied photographs of Korean Samhan C1 SH3301 190x90x57 mm clay bricks as a material and color reference. Create ONE seamless, tileable, perfectly front-facing diffuse albedo texture of a maintained Korean red clay brick exterior wall. No lettering, labels, border, logos, color chart or reference-sheet layout. The whole image is the wall surface. Stretcher running bond only: exactly THREE brick module widths across and exactly SIX complete horizontal courses vertically. Alternate courses offset one half brick. Every module is 200 mm wide x 67 mm tall: the visible clay brick is 190 mm x 57 mm with 10 mm mortar joints. The image therefore represents precisely 600 x 402 mm, landscape aspect approximately 1.493:1. Keep the first and last horizontal image boundaries through the middle of a mortar bed so vertical tiling joins perfectly; left and right edges must also join seamlessly. Straight parallel level courses, consistent rectangular fired clay faces with lightly eased corners. Natural restrained warm rust red and muted brown variation as seen in the real reference. Fine dense surface grain, tiny pores, very slight kiln variations, clean narrow mid-gray mortar recessed 2 mm. No heavily eroded edges, no white lime crust, no abandoned European reclaimed-brick style, no cracks, no moss. Completely flat diffuse even illumination with no directional cast shadow, no AO halos, no perspective, no vignetting, no glossy highlights. This bitmap will supply color only; joint height will be derived separately from the exact masonry dimensions. High resolution, sharp enough for a 1 m viewing distance.
note: 삼한C1 SH3301 제품의 비율·색·표면을 참고했다. 런타임에는 생성 알베도 한 장을 쓰고 줄눈 요철을 색에서 추출하지 않는다.
